name: night_pursuit
character: A film chase cue judged as a build-hit-release piece: a motif on the horns, a pulse that never stops and two slow-motion passages; it starts as `melodic` and changes nothing until a render measures a reason.

focus.label: a line the ear can follow
focus.reason: this type is defined by a figure, so a piece that declares it must carry one; the same list means a lead or a vocal is checked exactly like a melody
